description: Planifly helps you manage social media from your workspace. Connect your social accounts, browse media, create drafts, schedule or publish posts, and view available post and account analytics. OAuth lets you choose the workspace and permissions, and you can revoke access at any time. A Planifly account with connected social accounts is required; analytics availability depends on the social network.

defaultPrompt: List the social accounts connected to my Planifly workspace and show their platforms.
Show my latest posts and create a draft using the first suitable image from my media library; do not publish it.
Give me post and account analytics for the last 30 days, including sync dates and unavailable metrics.
